scope:
Bounded SH-4 cost of the actual SCCN/SCPS format-validation helpers.

Uses Make-derived native_static flags and synthetic records produced by the
existing public builder. These are one-time room-open costs, not draw costs.
Warm/cold-I models assume perfect D-cache; reported 32-byte data lines are
address footprints, not measured cache misses. Geometric validity is unproved.

traffic.scope:
Observe real opcode data accesses without inventing cache misses.

Instruction fetches are excluded; PC-relative literal loads are data loads.
The fixture maps cached RAM at low synthetic addresses, which become the
0x8c000000 alias only for the pipeline-model ELF. Distinct 32-byte lines are
working-set/touch counts, not measured fills or hardware bus transactions.

prefetch.scope: PREF requests observed separately; not demand loads, fills or guaranteed useful transfers

cold_icache.scope: Initially cold 8KB I-cache, once per complete sequence; synthetic ELF layout

model.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

arithmetic_control.scope: All M/Q/T inputs; preserves remaining state; one instruction; no data traffic; DIV1 unsupported.

sensitivity.label: MODELLED
sensitivity.note: Helpers run at section open. Do not multiply by rendered parts or claim a frame gain. Cold-I experiments are isolated, not additive.

limitations: Excludes section I/O, package opening, GC asset auditing, log output, original SCPS slot clearing, source geometric certificate validation, runtime cone tests, D-cache misses and GPU work. A public synthetic section does not establish private asset safety or console benefit.
